notes.title: Update 1.4.4
notes.content: [p][i]The Cycler’s ammo regeneration was kind of poopy so we’re giving it a big increase. The Jackrabbit also gets a smaller increase.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]The Cycler[/h2][list][*][p]Increased amount of ammo generated by dealing damage with your other weapon by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Cycler could become unusable when using Dump Charge and Rocket Burst together[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Au-Si Jackrabbit[/h2][list][*][p]Increased amount of ammo generated by dealing damage with your other weapon by 15%[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Shocklance[/h2][list][*][p]The Shocklance now supports gun crab cosmetics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Laying Cable’s damage resistance could increase every time you closed the menu[/p][/*][*][p]The Shocklance no longer cancels its charge if you have auto sprint enabled, start charging, and then start moving[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Swarm Launcher[/h2][list][*][p]Removed the part of Overload Contingency’s description that incorrectly said it consumed ammo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bruiser[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where your Nose Dive ground slam wouldn’t activate when leaping straight up and slamming straight down[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Prized Possession[/h2][list][*][p]We maybe fixed a rare crash on this mission but really we have no idea[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a couple spots in Titan City where Planetary Defense railgun batteries could spawn inside a wall[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a clipping lamp post in Titan City[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused enemies to fly outward when ragdolled inside the Ground Zero bubble[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Mycopunk is 20% off during the Devolver Digital Publisher Sale
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! [/p][p]We're still kind of recovering from the fact that Mycopunk exists on Steam at all, and now it's actually 20% off for the first time ever in the big Devolver Digital publisher sale! [/p][p]We started this game as a scrappy little college project, duct-taping together weird enemies and hoping our janky demo builds wouldn't crash (it did). Now, there are thousands of you out there gunning through swarms of mushrooms with your friends, and sending us bug reports that help us make a better game. And to whoever keeps submitting Roachard as a bug report: Stop. Or else.[/p][p]If you've been on the fence about jumping in (or convincing your friends to join your crew), this is the chance to squad up. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3247750/Mycopunk/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for being here with us and for playing. Oh, and stay tuned for more info on our upcoming updates very soon![/p][p][/p][p]—Pigeons at Play[/p]

notes.title: WEAPON DROP -- THE SHOCKLANCE
notes.content: [p]Hey. It’s Roachard![/p][p]What a turnout for that voting thing, huh?[/p][p]I would love to say it was a fair fight, but it looks like Faradics took the blue boy out back and made it quick. As promised, the Shocklance is being shipped out as we speak. Just make sure you update your Saxon Interface Client to receive one. Everyone who cast votes gets a complimentary order, and with such a high turnout, Faradics is makin the piece dirt cheap for any newcomers. But what the hell is this thing?[/p][p]The Shocklance is a close-range blasting weapon that fires electron fields through multiple enemies at once. These fields are quite something, and there’s zero limiting modules for them, so you [i]know[/i] it’s gonna get a bit weird.[/p][p]Looks like there are attachment slots for explosive charges, kinetic boosting, and… an extension chord? Why the hell would you wanna plug it in?![/p][p]Anyway, below is the official memo from the Department of Warstock Operations. Read it and get back to work.[/p][p]-Roach[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/8ef5b908e82c4fa5e47bd0f28a7f82f87c953850.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/a035e97857756d1e44df0a59329dbbe25af5175e.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]FULL 1.4 CHANGELOG[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3247750/view/509591543575740894"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Mycopunk Update 1.4
notes.content: [p]Hey folks, [/p][p]Update 1.4 has landed, and we're happy to announce that it includes a brand-new weapon - The Shocklance.[/p][p]The Shocklance comes with a suite of new upgrades. They're pretty cool,[/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3247750/view/509591543575741042"][b]You can read more about the Shocklance and some if its upgrades HERE[/b][/url][b].[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]-Pigeons[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5GKWcloDhkU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/d416e76f6d96f61e65221dcb9f9a563bbe4c7361.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/9af670cc210373daa4107a88bd1290f3f62845a0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/6acbd797d9c7c3627a09896eb132d671b53fb8a8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/a70f6270fa3eb8e4110d5ad66146a8edd76e0508.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/8e5073561db008342ab0c0f1d33d19e2de78c4a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]1.4 Patch Notes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Weapon Focusing[/h2][p]At level 4, you can now press MMB on a weapon in your inventory to focus it! You are much more likely to find upgrades for your focused weapon.[/p][p][/p][h2]Saxonite Transport Update[/h2][p]We’ve heard your feedback about Saxonite Transport being too long so we’re making some updates to this mission:[/p][list][*][p]Brought rocket launch pads closer to the truck garages so that Hunk gets to his destination faster[/p][/*][*][p]Added new launch pads in all levels to give this mission more variety[/p][/*][*][p]The first part of this mission now always requires 2 barrels rather than 3-4[/p][/*][*][p]Hunk’s waypoint gets smaller when you look directly at him so that it doesn’t block enemies[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Wrangler[/h2][list][*][p]Objects that you lasso can no longer miss and go flying past you[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Tumbleweed[/b][/p][list][*][p]The fast reload buff now stacks correctly when damaging targets[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Swarm Launcher[/h2][p][b]Scatterburst[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new animation when firing all of the Swarm Launcher pellets at once[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Skins[/h2][p]The Globbler and Carver each have a new skin that can drop randomly from enemies![/p][p][/p][p][b]The Carver - Pardoned[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/01c90605136f11692a32807367e579137b648002.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Globbler - Overgrowth[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/07f1f2b9c0b3ed6ae74a365c30099b9eb40e9a1f.png"][/img][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Upgrade pickup notifications are marked with NEW the first time you find an upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Clamber has been improved so it doesn’t send you flying off thin surfaces and won’t try to clamber you into ceilings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where damage numbers from meleeing a target could sometimes appear at the world origin[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bunch of areas where enemies could teleport to you[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where discovered Broken Frame upgrades couldn’t be crafted[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.4
notes.content: [h2]Corporate Contest[/h2][p]Oxythane and Faradics may be bogged down by numerous scandals, but their weapons aren’t! Both companies are ready to reveal more details about their respective weapons.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Accelerator[/h3][p][i]Accelerating Burst SMG[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fires shocking bursts that increase in size with each trigger pull.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Shocklance[/h3][p][i]Electron Railgun[/i][/p][list][*][p]Close-range shock weapon that pierces through targets.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Additionally, Oxythane has surprised Faradics by bringing in a [b]prize wheel[/b] for its loyal supporters.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Weekly Overtime Assignment[/h2][list][*][p]We accidentally made the next week’s Overtime Assignment start a day early, but we’ve been working off mobile hotspots for the past week (long story) and we don’t feel like waiting an hour to upload another build. So the next OT starts a day early…[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Employee Upgrades[/h2][p][b]Elemental Regeneration[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where this upgrade wouldn’t trigger health regeneration if you weren’t the host[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Duplicate Protection[/h2][list][*][p]We were previously calculating duplicate protection the WRONG way, which made it not work as often as it should. Now it’s fixed.[/p][list][*][p][i]You’re still more likely to get duplicates as you discover more upgrades because duplicate protection won’t change the rarity of a drop (i.e. it can’t promote an epic drop to exotic)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Upgrades are slightly more likely to drop for your equipped weapons & character. This behavior now only takes effect when you have undiscovered upgrades for your equipped gear.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Upgrade Crafting[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where crafting a random undiscovered upgrade could sometimes instead give an already-discovered upgrade for one of your equipped weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Buttons to craft undiscovered upgrades are now correctly greyed out if you have an ‘undiscovered’ upgrade waiting for you in the lost loot machine[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]C_AN\\\\S[/h2][list][*][p]Cr/n/u_ now drops an additional Saxonite and two additional upgrades each week, one of which is guaranteed to be exotic[/p][/*][*][p]\\_an\\us now drops one more upgrade on additional kills after his first death each week[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Gunship Cannon[/h2][p][b]Ballistic Charger[/b][/p][list][*][p]Missiles now play the nuke explosion sound when fired at [b]full[/b] charge[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Wrangler[/h2][p][b]Tumbleweed[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’re aware of a bug introduced in the last patch that removed the ability to stack reload speed boosts from dealing damage while sliding. We’re planning to get this fixed for the next update![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bruiser[/h2][p][b]Nose Bounce[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bouncing no longer consumes a charge when you have multiple Nose Dive charges available[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Scrapper[/h2][p][b]Saxonite Power Cell[/b][/p][list][*][p]The antigravity field now follows the grapple pole when it’s connected to another player with On The Go[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Mission Modifiers[/h2][list][*][p]Butter Fingers & Split Personality can now appear on normal missions[/p][/*][*][p]Increased XP multiplier from Butter Fingers & Split Personality to 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the chance of //ERROR_REDACTED// spawning[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Instances of the same upgrade can no longer change order when scrapping an upgrade or searching[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Clearance Certificates couldn’t be picked up when dropped from an enemy[/p][/*][*][p]The threat level slider in the lobby list now correctly snaps at each threat level[/p][/*][*][p]Wrangler’s Leopard skin now displays correctly in first person[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where you could get stuck with no weapons if you died right after picking up a broken player[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where the Amalgamation’s core could detonate and then become invulnerable[/p][/*][*][p]When using a controller, your look speed no longer slows when looking at detached enemy parts[/p][/*][/list]

[h2]Corporate Contest[/h2][list][*][p]Oxythane and Faradics are now accepting donations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Weapon Unlocks[/h2][list][*][p]New weapons are now unlocked automatically as you level up (secret weapons are still unlocked the same way as before)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Our previous weapon unlocking system had a couple big issues - mainly that unlocking higher level weapon meant that it would suck until you collected enough upgrades for it. By making weapon unlocks happen much faster we hope to better spread out the early-game love between your weapons.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Explosion Performance[/h2][list][*][p]Reverted a change from 1.3 that caused a large performance drop on explosions and other dithered particles. This will also temporarily revert our change that made the flamethrower effect more transparent near the center of your screen while we work on a fix for the performance issue.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Wrangler[/h2][p][b]Dash Immunity[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where immunity disappeared really fast when combined with the Carver’s Rage upgrade[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tumbleweed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where fast reload stacks weren’t reapplied every time you deal damage while sliding[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bruiser[/h2][p][b]Optical Attraction[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Optical Attraction effects weren’t visible[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration[/p][list][*][p]Min: 5.5s → 7s[/p][/*][*][p]Max: 6.5s → 9s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased range by 40m[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage resistance[/p][list][*][p]Min: 45% → 60%[/p][/*][*][p]Max: Max: 62% → 80%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Au-Si Jackrabbit[/h2][p][b]Heavy + Double Time[/b][/p][list][*][p]After the upgrade ordering changes in 1.3, Heavy’s fire rate changes were completely overriding Double Time. These two upgrades now work better in combination.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where your look sensitivity would increase instead of decrease when looking at a target while using a controller[/p][/*][*][p]Less kills are required for the Elemental Testing backlog task (to kill enemies with a certain element)[/p][/*][*][p]Backlog progress is no longer shown with decimals[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled broken inspects on the wrench and Planetary Defense scanner[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the heavy nuke charge sound wasn’t changing with the current charge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could freely switch between loadouts while in a mission[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Employee of the Month[/h2][list][*][p]Roachard’s winners from our discord employee of the month contest now have their plaques displayed in the drop pod attic[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Incoming Transmission -- Corporate Contest
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/5c9388cd910173cbec0107cfd4349e752cf69259.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hey folks. I've got some exciting new stuff to fight over![/p][p]After you kicked that Amalgamation’s ass, Saxon’s weapon guys are takin' more of an interest in our little cleanup job on New Atlas. If the fungus is gonna come swingin with a buncha creepy eyeballs, I say we slam 'em back with some new gear of our own, and [i]you[/i] get to vote on it![/p][p]Up on the ballot we got the bullet sprayin [b]Accelerator[/b] from Oxythane, and the blast slammin [b]Shocklance[/b] from Faradics.[/p][p]Oxythane’s big in aerospace, so whatever they’re up to is sleek and all fancy like. They supply the Saxon marines, and by the looks of it, this thing is gonna be capable of military-grade killing, all in a nice little package.[/p][p]Faradics is a bit of a wild card. They make cool shit, but I don’t think anyone understands a lick of it. Except me, of course. They’ve got their mitts on Saxon power grids, so you can bet whatever they’re up to is gonna be packin' a [i]lotta[/i] watts.[/p][p]Both of these beauties got an electricity thing goin on, so it’s up to ya’ll what kinda tasing you wanna get up to. You can vote for either company by dedicating missions to 'em, and doin' some little side jobs for bonus points. Whoever gets the most points will get the first requisition from Saxon and get express shipping right to the HUB. You’ll have to wait on the other one a bit while it gets mailed over through slipspace, but I’m sure the requisition won’t take toooo long.[/p][p][i]-Roachard
[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/f73cd877656f1181c408ed992c28485f9dd7b820.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/04401d5f7f378da3806d6acebdb671bc742776cd.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Hi there, Pigeons here. 
Many thanks to Roachard for that inspiring speech. Now we also have a LOT of balance changes arriving with this patch! We’ve been working to buff up many of the less useful upgrades for [i]every[/i] weapon. But first, we’ve got some updates on heavy weapons and weapon inspecting.[/p][p]Find out more in the official changelog below.[/p][p]Before you do that, though. Here’s a treat hot outta the void. Mycopunk x Abyssus are now bundled up together. That’s double the chaos, double the monsters, and double the 'why did I sign up for this' at a price that’s easier on your creds. One moment you’re knee-deep in fungal nightmares, the next you’re staring into the abyss of a crushing black ocean all yours in a single grab.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58162/Mycopunk_x_Abyssus/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/8e5073561db008342ab0c0f1d33d19e2de78c4a2.gif"][/img][/h2][h2]The Backlog[/h2][list][*][p]Guaranteed rewards for new skins now appear every 5 pages instead of 10[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance of one of the new Backlog skins appearing as a tier 4 reward on any page[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gun Inspects[/h2][list][*][p]You can now press [b]T[/b] to inspect your weapons![/p][/*][/list][h2]Heavy Weapons[/h2][list][*][p]Heavy weapon damage now scales with threat level above threat 3[/p][/*][*][p][i]In a future update we’re planning to give heavy weapons upgrades to help make them more useful in harder missions[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Bruiser[/h2][p][b]Unconditional Protector[/b][/p][list][*][p]Healing now scales with the number of Shield Projector charges you have[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Launch Reserves[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased amount of Nose Dive charge refunded[/p][list][*][p]Min: +25% → +50%[/p][/*][*][p]Max: +33% → +60%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Lead Flinger[/h2][p][b]Big Fat Doobie[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now decreases ammo capacity[/p][/*][*][p][i]We felt an ammo cap decrease for Big Fat Doobie was only fair since you fire way less bullets with it equipped[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Shrapnel Loading[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased damage[/p][list][*][p]Max: -64% → -78%[/p][/*][*][p]Min: -68% → -82%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Lucky Bastard[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced upgrade size from 12 to 6[/p][/*][*][p][i]Lucky Bastard is pretty good but its large size limited its usefulness in making builds. notes.title: 1.2 - The Backlog
notes.content: [p]Hey there! I'd give more of an intro but I don't really want to, and the changelog is the fun part anyway. So let's go straight into Saxon's new employee incentive program:[/p][p][/p][h1]The Backlog[/h1][p]The Backlog is an all new incentive program from Saxon that allows employees to work towards specific rewards.[/p][list][*][p]Each Backlog contains several Tasks, each with their own completion requirements and rewards.[/p][list][*][p]Tasks in each tier are exclusive, so choose wisely![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Once you complete a Task you will have access to the next tier with better loot and harder challenges.[/p][list][*][p]Your Backlog will only refresh when you finish a Task on the final tier. There’s no time gating, so no need to rush![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Task rewards include various resources, skins, and upgrades.[/p][list][*][p]If you’ve been hungering for something specific, this is a great place to look![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Employee Skins[/h2][list][*][p]Each employee has received a license for a new skin! These skins are currently only available as a Backlog reward.[/p][list][*][p]Wrangler: Leopard[/p][/*][*][p]Bruiser: Brawler[/p][/*][*][p]Scrapper: Tiedye[/p][/*][*][p]Glider: Firestorm[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Upgrade Stat Ranges[/h2][list][*][p]You can now hold your interact key (E by default) to display advanced stats when hovering over an upgrade! This will show min/max range values where applicable.[/p][/*][*][p]Holding interact while hovering over a skin will show an approximate probability of that skin’s combination of modifiers. Just for fun![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]You’re My Favorite![/h2][list][*][p]You can now favorite upgrades and skins with the ping button (MMB by default). Favorited upgrades always appear at the top of the upgrade list and can’t be scrapped.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Introducing Threat 7[/h2][list][*][p]Saxon HQ has authorized threat 7 missions for all employees. Good luck…[/p][list][*][p]Saxon Health Insurance plans do not cover accidents that occur on threat 7 assignments[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Threat 6[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased difficulty scaling based on number of players. Previously threat 6 was the only difficulty that didn’t scale enemy damage with player count. Now their damage is slightly increased with each additional player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where abomination health scaling was much higher on threat 6 with 2 players. Also increased overall abomination health scaling on threat 6.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Saxonite[/b][/p][list][*][p]The chance to get Saxonite from Threat 5 & 6 is pretty high, so we’ve slightly lowered it by 5%. notes.title: Call for Submissions - Roachard’s Employee of the Month
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="7_A8I7cIZPY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Hey. It’s Roachard.[/p][p]
Got word from the big guys upstairs that I could be doing a better job of “boosting morale” and that I should start giving out awards and shit. I told them that if they really wanted to boost morale around here I should get me more employees but I GUESS “positive reinforcement” is more budget-friendly than [i]actual[/i] reinforcements. Okay sure yeah.

So here’s what we’re going to do: You’re going to keep going down and doing the same [i]spectacular [/i]work you’ve been doing, [b]but this time you’re going to record it.[/b] That can be either through [u][url="https://www.nvidia.com/en-ph/geforce/geforce-experience/shadowplay/"]Nvidia Shadowplay[/url][/u], [u][url="https://obsproject.com/"]OBS[/url][/u], or [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/gamerecording"]Steam’s built in recording tools[/url][/u]. I cannot emphasize how little of a difference it makes to me. Shit you can even pull clips from your Twitch livestream if you’re one of those fancy types.

Take anything you want me to see, drop it in our [u][url="http://discord.gg/mycopunk"]Discord[/url][/u], and I’ll give it a look. [b]Whoever has the coolest, funniest, most shareable moments will be my very special employees of the month.[/b] That means you’ll get your video put up on company-sponsored social media and enhanced through color commentary provided by yours truly. Sounds pretty great, I know. And maybe [b]winners will even get a little bonus thrown on top.[/b]* If you’re extra special.

So get out there and show the galaxy what you’re capable of. 

Make me proud, champ.

[b]-Roach[/b]

[i]*Saxon has asked me to emphasize that any mention of a bonus will NOT materialize in the form of a pay raise.

notes.content: [p]Hello employees! [/p][p][/p][p]Now that the Amalgamation is out and disrupting Saxon’s operations, we’re hard at work on our next balance update. For this (and for future updates), we’re introducing an experimental beta branch, so you can help shape the game by giving feedback on changes before they go live to everyone![/p][p][/p][p]This branch will be our playground, and possibly unstable and often broken. notes.content: [h3]Dave vs Goliath[/h3][p][i]Yeah… this modifier was kind of overpowered for farming. notes.title: Mycopunk Update 1.0.3 + An Interview With Space.com
notes.content: [p]Hey employees![/p][p][/p][p]First of all, it's been an incredible weekend for us, as thousands of you joined the effort to clean the universe up of the fungal invasion. Thank you all for jumping in and for the incredible support you've given us.[/p][p][/p][p]We've read through your reports and, oh boy, you found quite a few bugs. This means we have to fix them I guess. So, here's our first shot at that. With this newest update, we've fixed many of the most important issues that were reported. We also made some balance changes to a few weapons and upgrades to make everyone's experience even better… see the patch notes below for details![/p][p][/p][p]We’re still hard at work finishing the next event (which was supposed to release with the end of fungal analysis, but you all completed that [i]way[/i] faster than we expected!) We’re also looking into tweaking other things based on your suggestions soon (yeah Prized Possession can be a pain on higher threat levels…)[/p][p][/p][p]Most important for this update, we’ve fixed one prominent bug that could cause you to get stuck in the menu when joining or disable your melee. Yay.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Mycopunk on [url="https://Space.com"]Space.com[/url]... Ok then[/h3][p]It's pretty wild, but we recently sat down with folks from [url="https://Space.com"]Space.com[/url] to chat Mycopunk. Read their piece below, and find out what some of our inspirations were, what the game looked like before it took its final form, and how the enemy design changed over time.[/p][p][url="https://www.space.com/entertainment/space-games/mycopunk-is-what-happens-when-borderlands-gets-a-nasty-fungal-infection-interview" style="button"]>> Read our interview with Space.com <<[/url] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/8e5073561db008342ab0c0f1d33d19e2de78c4a2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Skins[/h3][list][*][p]Tweaked stat curves on Factory skins to make them much less likely to drop with little to no hue shifting. This change is retroactive to any existing Factory skins.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that was causing Factory skins for the Cycler to sometimes drop with no modifiers[/p][list][*][p][i]These skins will unfortunately not be affected by our changes to the other Factory skins.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some parts of Glider’s Moonlit skin displayed as black instead of white[/p][/*][*][p]Glider’s skins now affect her wingsuit and rocket salvo in first person[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We also feel that skins are just a bit too rare, considering the massive amount of possible variations for each one, so we’re making them a little more common[/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased the chance of getting an oyster from scrapping a skin[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled the chance of an oyster spawning in a mission[/p][/*][*][p]Skins still have the same chance of dropping along with any upgrade drop[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Upgrades[/h3][list][*][p]The Engorge upgrade now correctly increases the explosion size instead of the projectile size[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players getting stuck in their menu after joining a crew if Hot Swap was equipped on their DMLR[/p][/*][*][p]The DMLR’s Voltaic Battery upgrade now actually deals explosion damage[/p][/*][*][p]Laser mode lasts longer on the DMLR when both Autocycler and Coronal Ejection are equipped[/p][/*][*][p]The Voltaic Grenade’s Higher Voltage upgrade now actually increases outgoing shock damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players getting stuck in their menu after joining a crew if Impact Cascade was equipped on their Incendiary Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]The Incendiary Grenade’s Napalm upgrade now actually increases your outgoing fire damage[/p][/*][*][p]The Voltaic Grenade’s Phase Housing upgrade now actually phases through shields[/p][/*][*][p]The Plate Launcher’s Nice Catch upgrade applies less of its element to you[/p][/*][*][p]The Plate Launcher’s Fencing Construction upgrade no longer damages players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Cycler’s Scorching Detonation upgrade not triggering when killing an ignited target. Scorching Detonation can also now cause itself to trigger if its explosion kills a target.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Lead Flinger's Fan Fire upgrade sometimes dropping with a really low damage boost. Minimum damage increase is now 12%.[/p][/*][*][p]The Bruiser's Modular Construction upgrade now appears correctly for other players[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons[/h3][list][*][p]Increased the Heavy Laser Emitter’s minimum fire interval so that it can’t be spammed[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the cost of unlocking new weapons by about 50%[/p][list][*][p][i]Since you already have to gain a bunch of XP to unlock weapons, we think the cost to buy them was too high, especially since the same resources are used to unlock upgrades.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Heavy weapons are cool, but we feel they could be even cooler, so we’re making some of them a bit more powerful.[/p][list][*][p]G6 Street Sweeper[/p][list][*][p]Increased ammo capacity from 5 to 6[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A16 Beam Ripper[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage from 550 to 600[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Heavy Laser Emitter[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage from 750 to 780[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Overtime Assignment[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the Overtime Assignment sometimes not giving its guaranteed rewards on the first completion each week[/p][list][*][p][i]Since some players missed out on their rewards, we’re resetting this week’s guaranteed rewards for everyone. More to come soon…[/p][p][/p][p]-Pigeons at Play[/p][p]:)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]In case you missed it[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3247750/view/536605983645896289"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Overview | Coming July 10
notes.content:
[p]Hey folks![/p][p]It’s now just a few days before release on July 10, and we are incredibly excited. With over 120,000 demo players (hopefully) waiting to hop into the full thing, we thought this would be a good opportunity to expand on why we’re launching into early access and what we’ll be doing throughout it. We plan to utilize these next six months to the fullest, so we thought it would be a good idea to outline our plans for that period.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/72bf16de758909ea14ae27e76a3a9d7aa617176f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Why Early Access?[/h2][hr][/hr][h3][i]TLDR: Because we want to…[/i][/h3][p][i]Even though we could launch straight into 1.0 and skip calling this Early Access, we still want to work out the kinks with the help of the community. We also want to tell you a story, which is why our primary focus will be on unraveling the mysteries behind your “benevolent” employers, Saxon, and the fungal takeover of New Atlas.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]A Narrative-Driven Approach[/h3][p]Early access isn’t just about fixing and balancing things. For us, it's a way to tell a story. The situation on New Atlas is constantly evolving, and updates will be rolled out as the Mycopunk world grows. Each content update is tied to the narrative in some way and will progress the overall story of Mycopunk as you battle the fungus for control of New Atlas. And with this arm’s race barreling ahead, there’s naturally going to be a lot of new gear, upgrades, and enemies that will roll out with these updates (all for free!).[/p][p][/p][h3]Special Assignments[/h3][p]The more narrative-heavy updates will include replayable story missions called Special Assignments, which serve as the focal point for their update. Special Assignments will be unique, handcrafted experiences that give us the freedom to push the gameplay beyond what’s possible in the average Myco-Mission. There’s a lot to discover about the fungal threat, as well as Saxon’s history, and we look forward to showing it to all of you.[/p][h3]
All Working Together[/h3][p]After all, to Saxon, you aren’t players. You’re [i]employees[/i]. Many content updates will involve the community in some way, whether that’s supporting your favorite arms dealer, scrounging around for sciencey-type things, or taking down enemies that threaten more than just your own crew. No health plan, no benefits, only your fellow wagies and a dream.[/p][h3]
Finding that Perfect Balance[/h3][p]We’re launching with a lot of content. There's, of course, a lot we still want to add, but we feel there’s enough [i]content[/i] in Mycopunk for a full 1.0 release. What’s not perfect quite yet is the [b]balance[/b]. With so many weapons, characters, and upgrades, it's impossible for us to test everything ourselves, which is exciting, as some combinations will require some tweaking. This is where YOU can help us! We need your feedback to ensure that everything gets in its proper place. That’s also why we’re collecting a small amount of usage data to ensure that we give special attention to any underutilized equipment.[/p][p]Don’t worry, we won’t kill your favorite build or weapon interaction - we love broken stuff, and only want to tune it down a bit. What’s most important to us is that you have a whole lot of fun and useful builds to choose from.[/p][p]We hope you’ll join us on New Atlas as we beat the game into the best possible shape it can be.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the official roadmap image below for more info and hints on what's coming in the near future. [/p][p][/p][p]-Pigeons at Play[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600774/9104a410387697447bc6bb80a8fd8a6336a76eb8.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]IN CASE YOU MISSED IT[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3247750/view/810198487112095167"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Pigeon Propaganda - 6/16/25
notes.content: [p]Hello employees![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who played the Mycopunk demo during Next Fest! We've had 120,000 players so far, which is pretty cool I think. notes.title: Pigeon Propaganda - 5/12/25
notes.content:
Welcome back :)

This week we’re talking about upgrades. I don’t have anything else to say so let’s do this.

[h1]Upgrades[/h1]

Time to go more in depth on our upgrade system and progression. Upgrades come in four rarities: Standard, Rare, Epic, and Exotic (common can go fuck itself). And what you’ve seen in the demo is just a small taste of the full set of upgrades.

Our intent with these upgrades is to let you modify your weapons and characters in interesting ways and actually change how they behave. Aside from standard rarity, we shy away from upgrades that only slightly change stats. +15% damage is BORING. But turning your high caliber rifle into a shotgun is COOL. We’re really excited for you to see all of the upgrades in the full game. I’m sure you’ll find so many broken combinations that we haven’t thought of.

Upgrades are neat. But our grid system is what makes them really interesting. As soon as we began prototyping the grids we realized there was no way we’d be able to balance all of the possible combinations. It’s a little worrying, but we can’t wait to see the builds you discover. One of the main reasons we’re doing early access is to let the community inform our balancing and future upgrades, so we’ll likely be tweaking a lot of the upgrades after release based on feedback and usage rates.

[h1]Crafting[/h1]

Since upgrades have random stats, we want you to be able to get rerolls without only relying on RNG. That’s where crafting comes in.

Scrapping an upgrade provides one scrap of that upgrade’s rarity. You can spend scrap to craft new upgrades. These can be crafted for a specific weapon or you can create a new roll of a specific upgrade. Crafting can only provide upgrades that you’ve found in the world at least once.

[h1]Character Upgrades[/h1]

Most character upgrades in the full game are unlocked through the upgrade tree, allowing you to get the exact upgrades you want without relying on RNG for your first drop.

You can spend skill points from leveling up to gain a new upgrade for any character. Once unlocked, variations of the upgrade can start dropping in the world.

Character and player upgrades also come with small random stat boosts which can:
[list]
[*] - Increase your max health
[*] - Decrease the health regeneration delay after taking damage
[*] - Increase run speed
[*] - Increase slide speed
[/list]

These are meant to help boost some of your base player stats as you collect more upgrades.



That’s it for this week! Have fun killing shit.

notes.title: Pigeon Propaganda - 5/5/25
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This is our first of what will (hopefully) be weekly posts going into detail on stuff and things.

It’s been amazing watching everyone play the demo, share builds, draw your favorite characters(!) and find secrets together! We’ve been working on Mycopunk for almost two years now and we’re so excited that you all can finally play it. We’ll have many more posts leading up to release, but for now we want to focus on changes we plan to make based on your feedback on the demo.

But first: [b]we’re going to keep the demo live until at least June.[/b]


[h1]Characters[/h1]

From our very official polls we’ve noticed a couple outlier characters, specifically Bruiser with a 14% pick rate and Glider at 42%. Glider is TOO popular and she will be [strike]fired[/strike] given a performance review.

Glider’s current wingsuit uptime and mobility blows every other class out of the water. Oops. We aren’t planning any major nerfs but we do need to bring her in line with the rest of the characters.

We’ve gotten a lot of feedback that Bruiser just doesn’t have enough horizontal mobility to keep up with their coworkers so we’ll be tweaking their nose dive (and maybe shield projector) to give them a little boost.


[h1]Difficulty Scaling[/h1]

We seen a lot of reports of missions being too hard when playing solo. We want to encourage people to play in co-op because co-op is fun, but singleplayer shouldn’t be much more difficult than a duo lobby. 

We’re looking at tuning down the difficulty when playing solo in threat 1 and 2. Scaling for threat 3 and above will stay the same for now to preserve their difficulty.

As with everything else, your feedback with be invaluable in balancing difficulty across all threat levels and player counts. Keep it coming!


[h1]Chaos Control[/h1]

Most missions in New Atlas come with near nonstop hordes of enemies. We think that’s pretty cool. But sometimes you want a (slightly) more relaxed experience. We’ll be playing around with adding an **enemy intensity** option along with the threat level during mission selection.


[h1]Hornet Missiles[/h1]

Hornets are too punishing, you say…

We’re decreasing hornet damage and reducing their tracking speed.


[h1]Pax East[/h1]

We’ll be at Pax East along with Roachard this week! If you’re there come stop by the Devolver booth. If you’re not there we don’t want to talk to you.


[h1]FAQ[/h1]

Some questions keep cropping up, so here are some answers, free of charge:

Will demo progress carry over to the full game?
[list]
[*]No. We’ve made some breaking changes since the demo PLUS we want everyone to start in the same place. But we’ll have a little gift for anyone who plays the demo (like a skin or something)
[/list]

Can I play offline?
[list]
[*]Yeah but some features that require internet (like community events) of course won’t work offline.
[/list]

Are there more weapons in the full game?
[list]
[*]Yes :)
[/list]

Will there be skins?
[list]
[*]Yes
[/list]

Is there a release date?
[list]
[*]Yes
[/list]


[h1]Next Up…[/h1]

We’ll have more in-depth posts leading up to release, but if there’s anything in specific you want more info on, tell us! See you next week when we talk about Overtime Assignments. Or something else idk.

notes.title: Step into the world of Mycopunk
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Here we are announcing Mycopunk. It’s a game. There’s a lot of cool stuff in it. We could tell you all about it, but that’s a lot of work. So you should stop reading and go play the DEMO.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581750/Mycopunk_Demo/

In case you’ve decided to keep reading (why??) let's take a look at some of the things in Mycopunk that we’re most excited about.

Mycopunk was born from our desire for a fun (FUN) co-op FPS that makes players want to keep coming back without any of that FOMO shit. This mostly manifested in three ways: shooting stuff is fun, progression is interesting, and [REDACTED].

[h1]Weapons[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YnCkOM5.gif[/img]

If you’ve played the demo you’ll know your weapons feel good to shoot and carving up enemies is fun. If you disagree, come tell us to our face in the Mycopunk discord. Most of us don’t bite.

Some weapons are what you’d expect. The SMG is an SMG. It shoots bullets. But from the beginning we wanted to have some really weird, cool ass weapons. One of our favorites is the Swarm Launcher — it launches a swarm (no way) of pellets that hover above the ground and will dive down on enemies when you release the trigger. Some of the Swarm Launcher’s upgrades let it do some really cool stuff, but we’ll get to that later.

We have four guns for you to play around with in this demo, and on release you’ll have many more. Those guns are SECRET. For now…

[h1]Upgrades[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7Ixp1LP.gif[/img]

Each weapon, character, and grenade has its own unique set of upgrades. There’s like a hundred upgrades in the demo and you’ll get WAY more when you play the full game.

Each upgrade has a hexagonal pattern, and you can equip as many as you can fit into an upgrade grid. This means you can make some really cool builds by combining upgrades. There are so many possibilities with this upgrade system, and we’re super excited to see the interesting builds you can make. And yes… there will be some really overpowered combinations that we probably won’t discover until you get your hands on the full set of upgrades — one of the main reasons we’re doing early access is to help us balance this massive system based on your feedback. And we promise not to nerf your favorite builds into the ground. Unless we feel like being mean.

[h1]Friend Slop[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U6PAFEX.gif[/img]

Fucking around with friends is fun. Killing friends is fun. In Mycopunk, you can make friends AND kill them. If you don’t have friends, join our discord or skip this section.

One of our goals for the H.U.B. was to give players a fun place to mess around between missions or while waiting for friends. Not being able to shoot guns in lobbies is BORING. Not being allowed to teamkill in lobbies is criminal. In the H.U.B. you can fire your guns, use your abilities, and run people over with a car. It’s a great place to test out new builds — on test dummies and your crew.

And Roachard is there.

[h1]Roachard[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uFuTrMd.gif[/img]

Roachard says you’re wasting your time. Go play the demo.

See you on New Atlas,
Pigeons at Play
